blockingFindings.description: Direct review of all current V167 previews confirms the sleeve surfaces remain detached from the posed arms and stretch across the chest in neutral and arms-up views.
The overskirt still collapses into sharply crumpled masses around the hips and back, with projecting panels and a broken hem silhouette.

Crouch and sit show the collar and torso garment displaced from the mannequin; prone shows the torso garment hanging below it with detached-looking trim. The pose surfaces remain visibly discontinuous.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
